title: Minna Alpha cookbook, Charlestown, Indiana, 12 Dec 1885
subject: Cookbooks
Recipes
Charlestown (Ind.)
description: This cookbook is hand written in a small journal. On the inside cover is written Minna Alpha Dec. 12th 1885-86. A search of the 1880 U.S. Census shows that Minna was born around 1870 and lived in Charlestown, Indiana. The recipes are both food recipes and home remedies. Some of the recipes have been dated (the latest being 26 Feb 1891) and have a name of who provided the recipe.
